qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of creating a new driver object for the ID Provider driver?
qa_pairs.output: Creating a new driver object for the ID Provider driver registers the driver within the Identity Vault so it can be configured, activated, and used to provision identity data. Without this object, the installed driver files cannot be executed by Identity Manager.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you create a new driver object for the ID Provider driver after installing the driver files?
qa_pairs.output: After installing the ID Provider driver files on the target server, follow these steps: 1) Open Designer and select the option to create a new driver object. 2) Choose the ID Provider driver type. 3) Follow the prompts to define the driver name and metadata. 4) Save the driver object in the Identity Vault. The detailed steps are documented in the "Creating the Driver Object in Designer" section of the ID Provider driver documentation.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the documentation steps required to create and activate a new ID Provider driver object.
qa_pairs.output: To create and activate a new ID Provider driver object: install the driver files on the server, create the driver object in Designer, optionally add packages to the driver, create ID policies, activate the driver, and refer to the specific sections – "Creating the Driver Object in Designer", "Adding Packages to an Existing Driver", "Creating ID Policies", and "Activating the Driver" – for detailed guidance.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which documentation sections provide guidance on configuring the ID Provider driver after the driver object is created?
qa_pairs.output: The documentation sections that guide configuration after creating the driver object for the ID Provider driver are: "Adding Packages to an Existing Driver", "Creating ID Policies", and "Activating the Driver". An additional reference titled "Adding Packages to an Existing Driver" appears a second time in the list.
